independence_evidence: The magazine's own description (quoted on Papercut's listing and in It's Nice That) says it was founded in April 2012 by its current editor-in-chief and creative director David Martin; no media-group ownership appears anywhere.
qualifies_reason: Founder-owned biannual fashion title with Issue 31 (Fall/Winter 2026-27, 'An Emotional Turmoil') on sale from late October 2026.
what_it_is: A very large biannual fashion and culture magazine (recent issues run to around 800 pages) covering womenswear and menswear through long fashion editorials, celebrity cover stories and interviews with designers, artists and actors. Each issue is themed and appears with several different covers. It is bought by fashion-industry readers and collectors of oversized fashion books.
